summary: A rejected refinement result and an accepted no_ship review open the same settling review obligation. An initial no_ship acceptance binds its findings, and the obligation then holds the delivery gate: record_delivery refuses while the evidence-bearing corrective return with the verification disposition stays admitted. Only a ship or absent verdict settles the obligation, only the newest completed review can bind, and no definition version changes.
title: An accepted no-ship review opens the settling review obligation
